visualReview.notes: All49 final views inspected:11 portable,11 shared-material/map-placement and27 medium-fi comparisons. Stepped limestone hall, eastern round tower, four crown spires, four lower pinnacles, projecting balcony and perimeter terrace retain the two inspected aerial pictures' character. The overextended smooth concrete support was replaced by a faceted weathered-rock apron beneath the immediate terrace. It is a bounded approximation connecting the building to coarse PMTiles ground, not a reconstruction of the whole cliff.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All11 final shared-loader images inspected. Common limestone, weathered limestone, painted metal and wood graphs supply reusable stone, rock, railing and door detail; glass uses local opaque PBR. Each graph loads once; unload releases geometry. Skyline bakes actual shared linear means in one draw; other levels use five draws. Six GLBs contain zero embedded bitmap textures.

mediumFiReview.notes: All27 final lighting/LOD images inspected.720-triangle skyline retains the stepped hall, tower, balcony mass, four crown spires and bounded rock support.2911 district adds openings and broad parapets;8835 street and9435 close-up add arches, corbels, railings, flags and coarse carved bands. Matched tiers and transitions pass the four triangle ceilings. PMTiles supplies approximate terrain fit; Italian neighbors and flat shared-loader ground are diagnostic.

geographicReview.notes: Two inspected aerial pictures show the stepped limestone hall, eastern round tower, balcony and four crown spires. Cached exact building outline and standard viewer PMTiles set orientation/location. Reconstructed terrace6.4m above the working anchor sample clears the coarse hillside; bounded foundations seat it against the sampled ground. Exact cliff edge and balcony clearances remain approximate. Anchor 34.128585443,44.430632946; heading 0.347692146382; standard PMTiles datum 21.217927594329787m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. The former smooth support is replaced by a faceted weathered-limestone apron beneath the immediate terrace. Rock apron dimensions are approximate.

fidelityReview.notes: Accepted bounded medium-fi exterior from two actual aerial pictures and standard viewer PMTiles. Signed eastern tower and cached exact building outline set the retained axis. Terrace6.4m above the coarse working sample and a faceted immediate rock apron provide approximate seating; dimensions, opening rhythm, flag shape, carved bands, balusters and rock shape remain reconstructed. The extended smooth support was rejected during review. The sheer cliff, long approach, sea surface, exact balcony clearance, vegetation and navigable interiors are outside this model's scope. No survey accuracy or ground cutout is claimed. Physical-device timings and continuous-motion shimmer remain pending.

legacyFidelityScope.notes: Reviewed against docs-src/guide/medium-fi.md. The 9123-triangle master uses five merged groups and four shared 256² graphs. Hex colors decode sRGB to linear vertex colors; skyline uses the shared-surface mean. Silhouette and identity features have priority over fine joints, iron scrollwork, fixtures and interiors. Reference images are linked only. Appearance approval is separate from geographic approval.

limitations: Two reference pictures and standard PMTiles define approximate current exterior fit; no bespoke survey sources.
Detailed original source geometry remains unchanged. An independent derivative adjusts vertical datum and bounded foundation skirts.
Stepped hall, round eastern tower, four tall crown spires, four low pinnacles, balcony and perimeter terrace provide identity. Openings, flags, balusters and floor heights remain simplified.

Coarse terrain cannot reconstruct the sheer rock face or exact balcony contact. A bounded immediate rock apron bridges the coarse PMTiles surface to the terrace; the sheer cliff face, long approach, vegetation and interiors are outside scope. No terrain cutout.
Four shared material graphs plus local opaque glass; no embedded texture images. Physical-device timing and continuous-motion shimmer remain pending.
